cohort: The cohort consisted of 238 pregnant women undergoing ultrasound screening in Korea.
finding: A simplified ultrasound-based scoring system, particularly the presence of two or more ultrasound features, demonstrated moderate predictive accuracy for Placenta Accreta Spectrum Disorders (PASD).
mod_finding: Prior uterine surgery was significantly more frequent in the PASD group, but the rate of previous cesarean section was not significantly different, suggesting its contribution to PASD risk might be less pronounced in this Korean population.
